scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('client/dist')){fs.cpSync('client/dist','dist',{recursive:true});} if(fs.existsSync('dist')){fs.cpSync('dist','client/dist',{recursive:true});}"
scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
